questions.question: When using a hand signal to turn, when should you stop holding the signal?

options.text: In the middle of the turn
Three or four seconds before making the turn

questions.correctAnswerText: Right before making the turn
questions.explanation: Hold the hand signal until you are close enough to the turn for others to see your intention. Stop signaling before you turn. You need both hands on the wheel to turn safely.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) is affected by all of the following except:

options.text: How much time passes between drinks

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are
questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much alcohol you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Physical fitness does not affect your BAC. The type of drink and how well you think you can handle alcohol also do not affect your BAC.

questions.question: An oncoming driver's high beams are too bright. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the oncoming vehicle
Toward the right side of the road
Toward the left side of the road
Straight down the middle of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded by the bright lights and lets you see enough of the road to stay on course until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Cause your engine to use more oil
Require your vehicle to need a tune-up sooner
Start grass fires on country roads

questions.correctAnswerText: Make you drowsy while driving
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases, reduces noise, and cools hot gases from the engine. A leaky exhaust can release dangerous fumes that cause drowsiness while driving. These fumes can be deadly.

questions.question: When making a left turn, you should not:

options.text: Move to the center or far left lane

questions.correctAnswerText: Cut the corner short
questions.explanation: Slow down and signal before turning left. Do not cut the corner short, as this may hit other vehicles.

questions.question: You must pull over for an emergency vehicle with flashing lights:

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from
Only if it is behind you
Only if it is coming toward you

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from
questions.explanation: Pull over to the right edge of the road and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights. Do this whether the vehicle is behind you or coming toward you.

questions.question: What color are signs for parks and historic areas?
questions.correctAnswerText: Brown
questions.explanation: Brown signs show parks, historic sites, and recreational areas. They help you find these places when traveling in new locations.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light means the same thing as a:
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop, just like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and go only when it is safe.

questions.question: When should drivers use low beam headlights?

options.text: When driving in fog, dust, or rain
When following closely behind another vehicle at night
When within 500 feet of an oncoming vehicle at night

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: Use low beams when driving at night, when following another vehicle closely, or when within 500 feet of an oncoming vehicle. Also use low beams in fog, rain, dust, sleet, or snow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downhill grade ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: You are waiting at an intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights so other drivers let you through.
Drive around the back of a car that is blocking you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning or changing lanes. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If another car hits you from behind, this keeps you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive to the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells drivers that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: Other drivers can follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than one with a single rider.
When passing a motorcycle, move completely into the other lane.
Motorcycle brake lights always come on when the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: When passing a motorcycle, move completely into the other lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need the full width of a lane. Make sure your whole vehicle is in the left lane before you pass a motorcycle.

questions.question: How far from an intersection should you park?
questions.correctAnswerText: At least 20 feet
questions.explanation: Do not park within 20 feet of an intersection. Parking too close can cause accidents.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a green arrow at a traffic light?

options.text: Merge into the lane the arrow points to.
Slow down and stop if it is safe.
Turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction. Be in the correct lane for the turn. Let any cars or pedestrians already in the intersection go first.

questions.question: If your car skids, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: Turn in the direction you want the car to go.
Turn opposite to the direction of the skid.
Turn any direction. It does not matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn in the direction you want the car to go.
questions.explanation: When your car skids, turn the steering wheel in the direction you want it to go. When the car starts to straighten out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A low railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What is the best way to merge onto a freeway?

options.text: Go slowly and wait for an opening.
Speed up faster than freeway traffic.
Turn on hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up to freeway speed so you can blend in safely. Cars entering the freeway must yield to cars already on it.

questions.question: At a stop sign, what should you do after you stop?

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for cars tailgating you.
Move when the car in front of you moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, look left first because cars from the left are closer to you. Then look right. Finally, look left again in case you missed any cars.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: An area where passing is not allowed
The blind spot around a large vehicle
An area only for motor vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot around a large vehicle
questions.explanation: "No zones" are large blind spots around trucks and big vehicles. Stay out of these areas when driving near large vehicles.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow pedestrian hybrid beacon mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow pedestrian hybrid beacon tells drivers to slow down and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show direction and distance to drivers.
questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background. They show direction and distance to help drivers find their destination.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot continue in your current direction.

questions.question: Highway signs that require drivers to follow specific rules are called:
questions.correctAnswerText: Regulatory signs.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must do. Breaking these rules can result in a penalty.

questions.question: What does a flashing red pedestrian hybrid beacon mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go only if the crosswalk is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go only if the crosswalk is clear.
questions.explanation: A flashing red pedestrian hybrid beacon tells drivers to come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in an urban district if no sign says otherwise?
questions.correctAnswerText: 30 mph.
questions.explanation: The speed limit in urban districts is 30 mph unless a different speed is posted.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. After completing the turn, where should your car be?

options.text: In the center of the street.
In the lane with the least traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the left lane.
questions.explanation: When turning left onto a one-way street, finish the turn in the left lane.

questions.question: When you see a steady yellow arrow at a traffic signal, you should:

options.text: Move into the lane the arrow shows.
Slow down and stop if it is safe.
Turn left after checking for oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Go ahead because you have the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop if it is safe.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow warns that a red arrow is coming next. Stop unless you are already in the intersection.

questions.question: Your accelerator gets stuck while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off the ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If the accelerator sticks, turn off the engine carefully. Move the ignition only enough to stop the engine without locking the steering wheel. Then apply the brakes and pull to a safe area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
Road work ahead means turn right.
The road ahead curves sharply. Slow down.
There is a side road to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves sharply. Slow down.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road changes direction at a sharp angle. Slow down as you would for a sharp turn.
